thread:
Hannah: Not sure how this slipped through CI but the onboarding README has a couple of sneaky DX issues that repeatedly pop up in support tickets. Two things: angle-bracket placeholder copies and an accidentally committed test token.
Hannah: Example from README (copy/paste friendly but problematic):
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=<YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>
node index.js
```
Hannah: New users literally paste the angle brackets and then file tickets like "auth failed, token contains <>".
Leo: Ugh, I've seen that. We should never show <...> placeholders in copy/pasteable snippets. Use `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_KEY` or show `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=REPLACE_ME` and call that out.
Nikhil: Also related: an internal test token (test_abc123_example) was accidentally left in an example response body in the README (not a real prod key, but still bad). Found via a quick grep by a new hire who then tried it and got a 401 - then opened a ticket.
security: Thanks for the flag. Even test tokens should not be committed in docs. We should rotate/blacklist anything that looks like a token pattern and run a pre-commit check to detect token-like strings in docs.
docs-bot: Snippet-linter alert: placeholder-angle-brackets detected in docs/onboarding/README.md line 14. Suspicious-token-pattern detected in docs/onboarding/README.md line 39 (token-like string matched: test_abc123_example). Rule IDs: docs-placeholder-2026, docs-token-pattern-2026.
support: We've had 5 tickets in the past month that turned out to be angle-bracket copy issues. Small change would reduce a lot of noise.
Leo: Proposed fixes: (1) Replace angle-bracket example with `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_API_KEY`, (2) remove the test token and replace with `<redacted-test-token>` if you must show a sample response, (3) add a snippet-lint rule to fail PRs that include `<` or `>` in env assignment lines and a rule that flags token-like regex patterns.
Hannah: Also include a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md: "Avoid angle-bracket placeholders in copy/paste snippets. Use REPLACE_WITH_... or describe the step inline"
security: I'll add a lightweight pre-commit check that greps for token patterns and angle brackets and runs in docs CI as well. We'll also add an audit step to revoke any accidentally leaked tokens (none were prod, but we should rotate if found).
docs-bot: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012 - removes angle brackets, redacts example token, adds lint rules and contributing note. Snippet preview pending.
Hannah: Great. Once PR merges can support mark the related tickets as "docs fixed". Thanks team! :thumbsup:
